title: Códice Cruz-Badiano
version: Inspected passages identified in research notes
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes, not a reproduction.

passages.note: The manuscript dates from 1552. Nahua physician Martín de la Cruz authored the work, Juan Badiano translated it into Latin, and Francisco de Mendoza commissioned its preparation. Its illustrations and text document knowledge of plants.

authors: Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia
